text:
liz-secg: hey — ran a rotation stress test against apac-east earlier and observed short TLS drops (~150ms) across a subset of services during cert renewal bursts. not widespread but spiky. anyone else see similar?

sam-infra: saw the 150ms blips on proxy-03 and auth-gateway-01. spike in 5xx and a couple of connection resets. logs show two renewals for the same leaf within ~25s.

ashley-crypto: hmm. double-renew within 25s is suspicious. rotator should stagger by jitter (5s–300s). can you paste the rotator job config for that run?

liz-secg: paste below from the job we used (sanitized):
```
rotator.job: {
  target: [proxy-03, auth-gateway-01],
  base_ttl: 86400,
  renew_before: 3600,
  jitter_range: [5,300],
  keystore_eviction: 60,
  parallelism: 10
}
```

ashley-crypto: keystore_eviction:60s — that stands out. if the evictor removes in-memory key material after 60s while other processes concurrently trigger a refresh, you can get overlap where a service unbinds the old cert and immediately requests a new one. if the KMS unwraps are rate-limited, you could also see queued waits -> renewals pile up.

kevin-platform: I pulled KMS metrics for that window — there were transient 429s around 3551237920. unwrap QPS hit the soft-rate-limit for the tenant key ring. also some retry backoff jitter caused clustered unwrap attempts a few seconds later.

sam-infra: that maps to the 25s double renew. proxy-03 logs show: 
```
2026-10-04T03:45:18Z proxy-03 cert-rotator: start refresh leaf
2026-10-04T03:45:43Z proxy-03 cert-rotator: unwrap -> 429 from kms
2026-10-04T03:45:48Z proxy-03 cert-rotator: retry -> unwrap success
2026-10-04T03:46:03Z proxy-03 cert-rotator: second refresh triggered by eviction
```

liz-secg: so eviction timer bumped a second refresh after the first succeeded. ephemeral window where both old and new cert handling caused connection resets.

ashley-crypto: mitigation ideas: increase keystore_eviction to 300s, lower parallelism, or implement a singleflight/lock per leaf cert to dedupe unwraps. also add a short grace period where old cert remains bound for 500ms post-unwrap to absorb in-flight handshakes.

kevin-platform: from platform side we can: bump KMS soft limits for the rotation job window, add client-side token bucket to avoid bursts, and surface unwrap 429s as a high-cardinality metric in the rotator tracing.

sam-infra: operational asks: can we get audit logs for KMS Unwrap and keystore access for proxies in apac-east from 3551237800–3551238050? need to confirm which services retried and which retried multiple times.

liz-secg: filing request now. also filing an incident note: "cert-ttl-jitter-keystore-eviction" and will attach the job config + proxy logs.

devops-bot: rotation-job/apac-east started by liz-secg at 3551237805. job-id: rot-2026-10-04-01

pagerduty-bot: alert: TLS-flap spike detected (apac-east) — 14 anomalies in last 5m. escalation: sec-oncall (liz-secg), infra-oncall (sam-infra).

ashley-crypto: for long-term: add canary staggers across host groups (A/B/C) rather than per-host random jitter. that reduces chance of correlated renewals when combined with eviction. also add a preflight check: if unwrap returns 429, delay other hosts in same shard by a progressive backoff.

kevin-platform: noted. i'll open a PR to add singleflight dedupe and expose unwrap 429s to telemetry. also propose default keystore_eviction increase to 300s for short-term.

sam-infra: quick patch to reduce impact: deploy rotator config change (keystore_eviction -> 300s) to apac-east canary group now?

liz-secg: +1, do canary then monitor for 15m. i'll tag audit and compliance in the incident note so changes have traceable approval.

sam-infra: rolling canary applied to 10% of proxies at 3551238000. monitoring dashboards: error rate down 60% in canary hosts so far.

liz-secg: good. next steps: (1) collect KMS audit logs and keystore access (sam), (2) PR for singleflight and telemetry (kevin), (3) update rotator defaults and run wider rollout after 24h canary (liz). logging action item: include unwrap 429 counts and keystore eviction timestamps in the incident artifact.

kevin-platform: noted. will add an alert rule for repeated unwrap 429s during rotations.

liz-secg: thanks all. filing a short postmortem draft after 24h of monitoring. :thumbsup:
